mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500B YoY indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase, signaling tightening with inflation, S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of tightening-with-inflation instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: UNRATE below the historical mean predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to the labor market's consistent influence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when UNRATE is below its historical mean are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% YoY, indicating a strong housing market, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window for this regime-conditional signal.
